name: Equinoxe Yachts
serviceArea: Italy and the Italian Mediterranean coast

description: Equinoxe Yachts is a Turin, Italy company offering yacht brokerage and crewed charter. Its public site covers buying and selling motor and sailing yachts, Mediterranean charter itineraries and the Sanlorenzo Charter Fleet. Established in 1986 and now part of the Sanlorenzo group, it serves yacht owners, buyers and private charter guests. The demo focuses on Italian brokerage and holidays along Italy's coast; vessel availability and charter terms require a current enquiry.
